text:
ITEM 1 | Roasted cauliflower florets, pale cream to golden-brown with darker browned and slightly charred edges, dry matte surface with some crumbly bits, florets about 2-3 cm across, clustered on the left side of the plate covering roughly 25% of the plate's area, moderate height of about 2-3 cm | 110
ITEM 2 | Mixed leafy greens, mostly dark green spinach-like leaves with some lighter green and reddish-tinged leaf edges, slightly glossy and moist-looking, piled loosely in the upper right, covering roughly 25% of the plate, about 2-3 cm high | 60
ITEM 3 | Dark red-purple grains or berries (likely pomegranate-like seeds) scattered among the greens, small, glossy and moist, about 0.5 cm each, in a cluster of roughly 3 by 4 cm | 10
ITEM 4 | Crumbled pale off-white soft cheese-like pieces, matte and crumbly, about 1 cm chunks, sitting among the greens near the red grains | 8
ITEM 5 | Golden-brown toasted nut pieces, irregular, matte with slight crunch texture, about 1 cm, mixed among the greens and red grains | 6
ITEM 6 | Avocado wedges, bright pale green flesh with a darker green skin edge, smooth and slightly glossy, cut into three crescent-shaped pieces each about 5-6 cm long and 2 cm thick, along the bottom right of the plate | 90
